climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: One of Chile's five principal wine regions, covering all vineyards in the Valparaíso Region. It includes Casablanca, San Antonio and Aconcagua Valleys.
